Hero_Desc_Vivi:
A silver dragon who was once ranked second to Daya.
She always tries to keep her surroundings clean as a germaphobe, but she is always sneezing due to her chronic cold.
Could it be that the apostles who have come into contact with Vivi are suffering because of Vivi's chronic cold?
Album_Hate_Vivi: Getting exposed as a mercury dragon instead of a silver one.
Album_Hobby_Vivi: Pouring mercury onto the roots of the Yggdrasil.
Album_Vivi1: A dragon introduced by Daya. Vivi is a dragon who is rarely seen, but she isn't really shy. She has quite a strong sense of caution and nearly never tries to get close to others.
Album_Vivi2: When I approached her to say hello, Vivi warned me to stay away. Apparently, it's a hassle to wipe off the steam that forms on their horns. It was a strange comment, but I guess being a dragon who values cleanliness means she's extra sensitive about things like that.
Album_Vivi3: Vivi seems to visit Monatium quite frequently. I heard she's collaborating with Hilde, the elven hospital resident, to research diseases in Elias. They seem very passionate about it.
Album_Vivi4: It seems Vivi found me fascinating once I got closer to her. She said something's off and poked me with her finger and tickled me, and I didn't know what to do. When I asked why, she just stared at me silently before heading home, deep in thought.
Album_Vivi5: A few days later, Vivi showed up and demanded an explanation. "How are you completely fine?" she asked. Apparently, everyone who stays near her for long ends up getting sick for days. Yet, I was totally fine. I had no idea what to say, so I just stood there awkwardly. She looked frustrated but also a little relieved.
Album_Vivi6: Vivi now occasionally comes over unannounced to clean my room or dust me off... We started talking more over time, and one day she suddenly asked if I'm not resentful toward Yggdrasil. She said that Yggdrasil tore me from my home planet and basically kidnapped me to Elias, and yet I act like nothing's wrong with that. Her words gave me a lot to think about.
Album_Vivi7: One day, I saw Vivi melting silver and pouring it over the roots of Yggdrasil. When I asked why, she said she was just cleaning the roots with silver. I'm not sure if that actually works... but if she says so, I guess it does.

LoveLetter_Vivi: Dear Master,How are you? I've mustered the courage to send this letter in an attempt to convey my feelings. How swiftly the time has passed! I must offer my sincerest apologies for my coldness at the beginning.However, noble souls are bound to recognize each other and as such, I soon came to grasp thy true worth, just as thou hast seen mine. Please continue to watch over me, and I shall do my utmost for thee and this world.Yours, Viviana Argentum.
LoveCall_Vivi:
Greetings, Master.
This maiden called because you entered her thoughts while she enjoyed an elegant tea time.
As I drank my tea, I remembered the warm iced Americano you served in the banquet hall.
Master, this maiden wondered how you had been.
Have you also wondered after this maiden?

This maiden has been well.
Ahem, it is exceedingly rare for this maiden to call first merely because she wonders how another fares.
The more noble one is, the more one must conceal one's heart and refrain from revealing it easily.
If your time permits, might you join this maiden for tea?
I do not say this to boast, but this maiden possesses considerable skill in brewing it.
You understand that even preparing tea requires technique, do you not, Master?
This maiden shall be waiting, so call again. Pray do not leave me waiting too long.
